lines.text: You say you love me when the lights go down
Hold me like you mean it then you shut me out
You want the softness, you don’t want the rest
Kiss me like a promise then you fail the test
You take the parts that feel good on your hands
Leave the girl who talks and takes a stand
You love me but you don’t like me
You keep me close but you don’t try me
You want the fire, not the girl I am
You love me but you don’t like me
And it still breaks my heart
I laugh too loud and you look away
I tell the truth and you don’t stay
You like the picture hanging on the wall
Not the woman standing in the hall
You take the night and leave the day behind
Call it love when it’s just passing time
You love me but you don’t like me
You keep me close but you don’t try me
You want the fire, not the girl I am
You love me but you don’t like me
And it still breaks my heart
Don’t call it love if you don’t like my mouth
Don’t hold me close just to shut me down
You want the “yes,” you never want the fight
If you don’t like me, don’t come back tonight
You love me but you don’t like me
You keep me close but you don’t try me
You want the fire, not the girl I am
You love me but you don’t like me
And it still breaks my heart
